evaluations.detail: Derived context layers L0, L1, and L2 are completely discardable and rebuildable from durable ResearchDocument state.
Tiered L0 discovery (<200 chars), L1 structured overview, and bounded L2 excerpts prevent dumping entire source files into agent context windows.
Core OpenViking research URI mapping, layer derivation, staleness checking, and fallback routing require zero remote LLMs.
